## Check your R setup

Let's make sure everyone's R installation is ready to go.

1.  Confirm you're on a recent version of R

2.  Install pak, if you haven't already:

    ```r
    install.packages("pak")
    ```

3.  Install/update devtools and friends:

    ```r
    pak::pak("devtools")
    ```

4.  Run a situation report and check that everything looks good:

    ```r
    devtools::dev_sitrep()
    ```

## What's changed?

Where are the significant changes since [R Packages](https://r-pkgs.org)?

* 80% AI
* 15% Positron
* 5% standalone CLIs written in rust (e.g. air, rig, quarto)

## Overall

* More changes in the last year than last 10 years combined, and doesn't look like the pace is going to slow down
* Non-obvious consequences because the cost-benefit ratio for many tasks has radically changed
* We are still figuring out what it all means
* Keep exploring and experimenting; hold loosely to your hypthoeses
* We hope you'll learn something useful; and we also expect to learn from you!

## The good news

On the whole you're well positioned to benefit from AI:

* Plain text workflows are equally accessible to humans and agents
* Baseline scepticism will serve you well (but don't let it imprison you)
* Human knowledge still super important!
* Subject matter expertise now more important that programming skill
* Development best practices now much more accessible
